purpose: First TurtleBot3 timed-blocker pilot targeting recovery followed by success
timing_basis: e015 accepted its goal near episode simulation time 6 s and reached 2 m in 6.126 wall s. The 3 m goal requires about 9.4 s of forward motion at the platform's 0.26 m/s cap. A partial blocker at 1.5 m should stop forward progress before the goal; removal at fixed simulation time 29 s targets the first progress-recovery boundary without using e016 observations.
inclusion_rule: Include in later development evaluation only if simulator/capture gates pass, terminal status is succeeded, recovery history is complete, at least one unique recovery attempt is recorded, and evaluator truth confirms actual blocker removal.
mismatch_rule: Retain any valid artifact as calibration and do not alter timing, tune the same run, or relabel its family after observing the result.
evidence_boundary: Blocker geometry and removal timing are evaluator-only. Robot-visible explanation inputs may describe only captured BT/action mechanisms unless a separately defined intervention analysis licenses a stronger statement.
